Small Target, Dogfighter, Anti-Light, Astromech, Interceptor Shielding

The nimble Alpha-3 Nimbus or V-wing for short offers excellent durability for a light interceptor. Equipped with rapidly recharging Interceptor shields and an astromech for onboard repairs the fast and agile V-wing excels at dogfighting light craft such as the numerous CIS' unshielded lightly armored droids it was designed to counter. Armed with low-range light repeating Lasers it lacks the firepower to take on more heavily armored craft however. While old, the V-wing is hardly obsolete when used appropriately and has proven effective against newer light fighter models such as the TIE Fighter, adding to its popularity by pirates and para-military organizations alike. Best used to dogfight lightly armored foes lacking the damage output to pierce the V-wings rapidly recharging shields.

Armor: Light 2x Light Laser Agility: 2.025 Max Speed: 4.0 SP: 18(4.5/s) HP: 28(1/s) 8 Models per squadron.

Light laser: rapid-fire, short-ranged, weak vs armor 5 ||| 5 | 4 | 2 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 0.5s reload, 150m range.

Dogfighter, Anti-Light, Outdated

The V-19 Torrent is a true relic of the Clone Wars, increasingly phased out of service by 20 BBY in favor of V-wings and the Arc-170. This was due to its large size, lack of shields and only middling armament. However, it’s still a plucky, nimble fighter that can stall Peer-Adversaries until modern interceptor backup arrives.

Armor: Medium 2x Light Laser, 1x Concussion Missile Agility: 1.9 Max Speed: 3.5 HP: 36 6 Models per squadron.

Light laser: rapid-fire, short-ranged, weak vs armor 5 ||| 5 | 4 | 2 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 0.5s reload, 150m range. Concussion missile: crippling debuff, long-Ranged, no shield penetration. 20 ||| 20 | 15 | 8 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 500m range. Applies -85% Firerate debuff to Fighter/Bomber for 12s.

Small Target, Dogfighter, Armor-Piercing, Interceptor Shielding, Powerful Engines

Focussing on speed and agility over all other attributes, the elegant and aerodynamic N1 Starfighter, or Naboo Starfighter is an expensive light interceptor used exclusively by the people of Naboo. The N1 is extremely small, thin, and very difficult to hit, capable of dodging even missiles while dogfighting and equipped with rapidly-recharging Interceptor Shielding quickly absorbing any light impacts and an astromech for self-repair. While the Naboo Starfighter is a high performance interceptor, it is only armed with twin repeating Light Lasers and a Homing Torpedo launcher, and its luck can quickly turn against craft with medium to heavy armor, or dedicated interceptors capable of breaching its light shields and armor. Best used to dogfight against lightly armored craft.

Armor: Light 2x Light Repeating Laser, 1x Homing Torpedo Agility: 2.0 Max Speed: 4.0 SP: 14(4.5/s) HP: 21(1/s) 8 Models per squadron.

Light laser: rapid-fire, short-ranged, weak vs armor 5 ||| 5 | 4 | 2 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 0.5s reload, 150m range. Homing Proton torpedo: tracks target, ignores shields, good vs armor. 20 | 18 | 16 DMG vs L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 425m range. Applies -25% Max HP debuff to Fighter/Bomber/Gunship/Corvette for 14s

Small Target, Anti-Large, Dogfighter, Multi-Role, Armor-Piercing, Powerful Engines

The N1-b Starbomber, or Naboo Starbomber is an expensive starfighter that focusses on speed and agility over all other attributes, like the N1 Starfighter. Equipped with a second Proton Torpedo bay, more armor, and standard shields, the N1B is nevertheless as fast and agile as the N1 thanks to its secondary set of thrusters allowing it to keep up with the fast interceptors, making the N1-b an excellent fast strike bomber often accompanying the N1.

Small Target, Dogfighter, Powerful Engines, Anti-Light, Astromech, Interceptor Shielding

The Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor, also known as the Jedi Interceptor, was a Republic air superiority fighter produced by Kuat Systems Engineering shortly before the Clone Wars. It was primarily designed for use by the Jedi Order, necessitating a craft that was hyper maneuverable and with explosive acceleration potential. The modern iterations of the Delta-7 possess a modest armament and an internal hyperspace drive, eschewing the need for the bulky Hyperspace ring of the past. Best used to dogfight lightly armored foes and to stall heavy armored craft until backup arrives.

Large Unit, Anti-Large, Ion Torpedo, Terrible Dogfighter, Armor-Piercing, Astromech, High Capacity Shielding

Serving in the Clone Wars with distinction, the BTL-B Y-wing continues to be a durable, reliable, and versatile craft. Strong shielding protects the Y-Wings heavily armored chassis, and an astromech aids in onboard repairs. The Y-wing is best used against slow and bulky craft such as gunships, or to bomb starships, where its ion torpedoes can drain starship systems power. Due to its sheer durability and turreted ion cannon that lowers the firerate on hostile starfighters, the Y-wing can often deal with light resistance such as basic TIEs on its own. Compared to stripped down Rebel operated Y-wings, the BTL-B has heavier armor and loses some of its turning radius. Dispite its versatility the Y-Wing is an easy target, suffering from low maneuverability and a large target profile.

Armor-Piercing, Mass-Produced

The Hullcracker CVB (Clone Variant Bomber) is a light torpedo bomber modification of the Z-95 Clone Variant Interceptor built by the Republic during the Clone Wars. While this makes the CVB a relatively cost-effective light support craft against corvettes and frigates, it inherits the dog-fighter focused air frame of the CVI and its shortcomings. Namely, while faster and more maneuverable than a typical Z-95, the Hullcracker CVB is less bulky and has less survivability for its Clone pilots. Ultimately, it was considered an acceptable loss.

Dogfighter, Mass-Produced

The Z-95 Headhunter CVI (Clone Variant Interceptor) is a specialized variant of the venerable Z-95 craft built by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Due to being designed exclusively for Clone pilots, it boasts a number of features that improve its design but are harder for outsiders to learn. These improvements all result in a faster, more agile craft that hits harder, but come at the expense at some of its durability. While overshadowed by most other later fighter options, the Z-95 CVI is a solid garrison capable of being produced fairly cheaply.

The new standard Headhunter model is equipped with Concussion Missiles, making the Z-95 more effective than it should be at supporting friendly fighters against hostile starfighters, severely debuffing their firepower thereby allowing friendly craft to more cost-effectively deal with them. On its own, the standard Headhunter is not very good at anything but be annoying thanks to its debuff.

The Z-95 CVMR (Clone Variant MultiRole) is a specialized variant of the venerable Z-95 craft built by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Due to being designed exclusively for Clone pilots, it boasts numerous features that streamline its design but are harder for outsiders to learn. The CVMR represents the apex of the Hardliners airframe refit efforts. It preserves and surpasses the survivability of the original Z-95 and the agility of the Z-95 CVI, seeing usage late into the Galactic Civil War era.

Armor: Medium 2x Medium Laser, 2x Concussion Missile, 1x Proton Torpedo Agility: 2.0 Max Speed: 3.9 SP: 30(3/s) HP: 35 8 Models per squadron.

Applies -85% Firerate debuff to Fighter/Bomber for 12s.

The Rapid-32 Assault Interceptor, known as the R-32, is a Space Superiority Starfighter designed by the Incom Corporation in the final months of the Clone Wars. Striking a good balance between affordability and performance, it serves as a hyperspace capable interceptor for the Republic Navy. The R-32’s armament consists of the expected laser cannons and concussion missiles, though it notably utilizes an anti-starfighter Ion Torpedo for a strong alpha strike capability. Best used against valuable or shielded starfighters. Vulnerable to being overwhelmed by cheaper, light starfighters.

The J-45 ‘Sabre’ is an advanced, twin-seat multirole fighter developed by Rothana Heavy Engineering and Koensayr Manufacturing. The Sabre features underslung missile pods that can swap between AP and HE missiles during flight. The flexibility provided by this allows the J-45 to be a versatile threat against both warships and fighters alike, though it can be punished for its lack of speed and somewhat poor turning radius. Vulnerable to high-end dedicated interceptors.

Very Large Unit, Anti-Light, Repair Crew, SLAM Engines

The Naboo-built PT-1 uses advanced SLAM engines that would later be used on the K-wing. Focussing mostly on speed over every other trait, the PT-1 is poorly armored and shielded for a gunship, but can easily outrun most opponents. After the Battle of Naboo made clear the need for area-denial weapons, the PT-1 was armed with High Explosive missiles to quickly wipe out large groups of lightly armored craft. The Rebellion makes thankful use of these against the Empires TIE swarms.

Very-Large, Dogfighter, Glass Cannon, Repair Crew

For in-atmosphere operations there are few gunships as effective as the LAAT, but in space it is but one among many. Poorly shielded for space gunship standards and a large target, it is nontheless heavily armed with 2 AP-missile launchers, 3 laser turrets, and 4 beam cannon turrets. In space, the LAATs beam cannons are vastly less effective, firing regular laser projectiles at far closer range. Capable of engaging enemies from all sides, it is most effective in a dogfight, dispite its poor agility and shielding.

Very Large Unit, Anti-Large, Heavily Armed, Terrible Dogfighter, Repair Crew, High Capacity Shielding

Where other Incom-built designs such as the T-65 X-wing or UT-60 U-wing were well-balanced and sophisticated designs, the monstrously large XB-17 super heavy tactical bomber, or "The big dumb bomber" as it came to be known, was far less elegant. A heavily reinforced hull protected by thick armor plating were prioritized over speed and agility, and even the previously planned variable s-foil mechanism was replaced by static radiators encased in plating. The sheer amount of raw materials required to construct and maintain such a fleet of massive dedicated bomber craft were unavailable to the resource-strapped Rebellion, and by the time the Alliance had secured the means for supporting the mass production the XB-17 was seemingly built for, better options for powerful bomber craft were available to the Rebellion.

Armor: Heavy 2x Quad Heavy Laser Turret, 1x Heavy and 4x Standard Proton Torpedo Agility: 1.15 Max Speed: 2.25 SP: 280(5/s) HP: 330(1/s) 6 Models per squadron.

Land Bombing Run Unit Bombing Run Ordnance: High Explosive Bombs, effective against large concentractions of units. Bombing Run Type: Single drop, 1 massive high explosive bomb

Very Large Unit, Anti-Large, Armor-Piercing, Repair Drones, Support, Adv. Materials, Repair Crew, High Capacity Shielding, Slow

Built intentionally as a slow flying fortresses in the days of the Republic to prevent usage by pirates, the heavily armored Gozanti is an extremely durable gunship and transport equipped with repair drones it can use to facilitate repairs to itself or nearby craft. Armed with heavy laser turrets and a forward-mounted torpedo launcher it is easily capable of defending itself against large units and hostile gunships, but its appalling agility and top speed make it an easy target for heavy weaponry. Nevertheless it performs its intended duty admirably as the Gozanti has seen many decades of service and continues to stay relevant in the age of the Empire. Best used to tank endless volleys of small-arms fire and support surrounding craft with its repair drones.

The Consular-class Cruiser (otherwise known as the Republic Frigate) is a diplomatic vessel turned warship from the early days of the Clone Wars. The Charger C70 Refit saw the vessel armed with five Heavy Dual Laser Cannons alongside a Dual Ion Cannon, making these ships excellent escort vessels for anti-starfighter duty or stunning enemy vessels. Its powerful engines allow it to quickly chase down fleeing vessels or escape danger.

The Crusader-class Droid Platform, otherwise known by its class designation XX-777, is an entirely automated warship produced by a joint venture between the Corellian Engineering and Loronar Corporations. Despite these core world origins, the XX-777 sees widespread usage among Separatist Holdout groups due to their robust corporate espionage network. It functions in both a long-range Ion fire-support role as well as providing some Anti-corvette and Anti-gunship protection thanks to its specialized missile loadout.

Max speed: 2.5; Shield points: 500; Hit points: 1900

Jak Kannadee is something of an enigma. He was found at the Polis Massa medical center after suffering severe head trauma consistent with a slugthrower but is either unwilling or unable to provide details of how he suffered it. His larger-than-life personality, hard to place accent and lack of any official documentation all drew concerned questions when Kannadee subsequently enlisted in the Republic Navy. However, no one can deny his effectiveness. Within 6 months, Jak Kannadee was commanding his own Consular-class, requesting the designation CR-109.

Obi-Wan Kenobi is the greatest example of a Jedi the Order has produced in generations. He is everything his late Master needed him to be and more. From an unsure Padawan at the dawn of the Separatist crisis, Kenobi grew to be a legendary warrior, a wise Mentor to Anakin, a dynamic member of the Jedi Council and a peerless wartime commander. But these achievements are also burdens. The costs to the galaxy, and to his psyche, will be astronomical if he fails in even one of these duties.

Kenobi commands the Arquitens-class, “Short Negotiations”, as his starting flagship. With a vastly improved loadout, it can chew through enemy corvettes and still hold its own against threatening large vessels.

Max speed: 4; Shield points: 3500; Hit points: 2500

Fleet commander: Obi-wan Kenobi’s Soresu mindset inspires smaller ships to prioritize defense and stronger static positions. All corvettes and frigates on the field with him do -10% Damage and have -5% Movement, but gain +25% shields and +20% health.

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

Special Structures: Republic_Shipyard_1 Republic_Uplink_Command

Commander Lorth Needa is a young and largely untested officer hoping to make a name for himself in the Clone Wars. Hailing from Coruscant from a large and distinguished family, his cushy upbringing has not afforded him many opportunities yet for real frontline combat. Commander Needa is ready and waiting to either deploy to the front or prepare for the nightmare scenario of the war arriving at Coruscant itself.

The Integrity is a Carrack-class Light Cruiser, featuring Heavy Flak Lasers for enhanced anti-starfighter defense and Heavy Turbolasers for long-range strikes against capital ships. It is a versatile cruiser, excelling in both defensive and offensive roles but vulnerable to close range engagements with larger ships or dealing with numerous enemy warships.

Max speed: 3.5; Shield points: 3500; Hit points: 4500

Fleet commander: Commander Needa is a practitioner of Wolfpack tactics, tentatively labeled in Republic Doctrine as “Coordinated Attack Groups”. All Carrack-class Light Cruisers in battle with him gain +30% Damage, +25% Shield Strength and +25% Movement speed.

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

The MTC was designed by the Empire to efficiently provide a variety of logistics solutions, by swapping between mission function modules. It's capabilities include natural disaster relieve, post combat search & rescue, repair & salvage operations, planetary suppression and pacification, rapid planetary and system exploration, including natural resource surveys to swiftly assess the viability of newly found systems to support colonization. In combat the slow Modular Taskforce Cruiser is completely incapable of defending itself, and can be deployed only as a support craft to a larger fleet.

Fleet Logistics & Repair Module: This module provides a construction cost and time reduction of 15% to Corvettes, 10% to Frigates and 5% to Capital ships on the planet the MTC is stationed. This bonus does not stack with multiple MTCs. In combat, it repairs Corvettes, Frigates and Capital ships in an area around the MTC, and can deploy fields of repair drones for repairs further away.

Max speed: 2.0; Shield points: 10000; Hit points: 10000; 1 Skipray (0); 1 Combat Shuttle (1)

Captain Jan Dodonna is a rapidly ascending figure in the Republic military, achieving widespread notoriety after the decisive destruction of the Bulwark fleet at Anaxes. A consummate soldier, Jan leaves his ego at the door and embraces a true selflessness for a cause. This is something he demonstrates often, whether it be by buying time for the Victory fleet at Anaxes or later in his defense of Yavin base as a Rebel. However, Dodonna’s also notable for pushing advances in starfighter doctrine and design.

Jan Dodonna commands the Ardent Hope, a Victory-class Star Destroyer, which boasts emergency shield power and a hangar larger than its peers.

Max speed: 2.5; Shield points: 10000; Hit points: 15000 Tech 1 Garrison: 1 V-19 Torrent (4) Tech 2 Garrison: 1 Z-95 CVI (2), 1 Z-95 CVB (2) Tech 3 Garrison: 1 Arc-170 (2), 1 BTL-B Y-wing (2)

Fleet commander: Captain Dodonna’s Judicial Forces officer background and his extensive knowledge of starfighters provides a 15% increase to shield strength and a 10% engine power increase for all Republic Starfighters in battle when he's present.

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

Special Structures: Republic_Shipyard_2 Republic_Uplink_Command

Captain Terrinald Screed was a decorated officer in the Republic Judicial Forces and would go on to major success in the Republic Navy. He favors a decisive battle doctrine, leaning on breakthroughs generated through a strong strike delivered by a maneuverable Frigate/Capital Ship fleet. These ideas are notably credited with the defeat of the Bulwark Fleet at Anaxes in cooperation with Captain Dodonna. Captain Screed enjoys a close rapport with Palpatine.

The Arlionne, a Victory-class Star Destroyer, is Captain Screed’s flagship in the Victory fleet. Its custom loadout mirrors the Captain’s personal preference for Proton Torpedo Launchers over Concussion Missile Batteries.

Max speed: 2.75; Shield points: 10000; Hit points: 15400; 1 Headhunter (1); 1 Arc-170 (1)

Fleet commander: Captain Screed’s Decisive Battle doctrine results in better combat performance of corvettes, frigates, and capital ships. This boosts their shield strength by 10% and movement speed by 20%.

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

The Victory-II 'Longbow' frigate is an intermediate-ranged anti-fighter vessel that acts as a screening frigate within the Republic and Imperial navies. It features an array of laser cannons and turbolasers to fend off small enemy craft, alongside its bow mounted strikecraft targeting missile system. Despite its respectable performance in the Clone Wars and early Imperial era, the Victory-II saw diminished usage over time thanks to increased corvette performance and overshadowing by carrier-based fighter solutions.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 4000; Hit points: 6375

Victory I-class Star Destroyer. Designed during the Clone Wars, the Victory I was the Republic Navy’s first iteration of a larger ship-to-ship combat vessel to support the Venator-class. This greater offensive capability is primarily derived from its large number of concussion missile tubes, capable of devastating alpha strikes on enemy shield generators. However, its engines are slow and inefficient, leaving the Victory-class vulnerable to falling out of position and struggling to keep pace with faster fleets.

Victory II-class Light Star Destroyer. Originally planned as a life extension program for the Victory I, the design diverged significantly enough that it was designated the Victory II. This late Clone Wars era vessel features improved engines compared to its predecessor, Heavy MagPulse missiles and strong Ion Cannons. The Victory II benefits from being grouped with fire support vessels, as it can struggle to secure a kill after striping the shields. Vulnerable to heavily armored warships. Effective at long range shield support.

Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker was born of the force and has the greatest raw potential of any sentient the galaxy has seen thus far. Born a slave, Anakin would join the Jedi order long after admissions were typically considered and with emotional connections that gave the Council pause. Publicly, he is already a war hero, a paragon of the Order and the hero without fear. But there are cracks beneath this facade. Skywalker has a secret wife. He breaks with Order doctrine when convenient. And in rare moments, he unleashes a rage that is terrible to behold. Time will tell if his raw potential will be used for the betterment of the Galaxy or if he will be enslaved once again by it.

Skywalker commands the Resolute, a modified Venator-class Star Destroyer featuring a stronger array of Heavy Turbolasers and a robust fighter complement.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 15000; Hit points: 19000

Tech 1 Garrison: 2 V-19 Torrent (6), 2 Z-95 CVB (6), 2 LAAT (6) Tech 2 Garrison: 2 Z-95 CVI (6), 2 BTL-B Y-wing (6), 2 LAAT (6) Tech 3 Garrison: 2 Z-95 CVI (6), 2 BTL-B Y-wing (6), 2 ARC-170 (6), 2 LAAT (6)

Fleet commander: Anakin throws himself into firefights with a near suicidal confidence that his men unfortunately share. All strikecraft, capitals, battlecruisers, and dreadnaughts rush in head-first, with 33% increased movement speed firing their weapons for 30% extra damage, at the cost of 30% shield strength.

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

Jedi Master Kazdan Paratus is tormented. He constantly hears the quiet echoes of all that he’s lost and the whispers of his perceived cowardice from Order 66. Paratus escaped the Temple to live in filth on the Industrial wasteland of Raxus Prime, utterly alone, for years. This pressure cooker of guilt and loneliness catapulted him into full blown madness, leaving him a raving hermit worshipping a replica of the Jedi Temple constructed out of trash when he was discovered. Kazdan has since eagerly applied his skills as a mechanic and salvager to the Republic Loyalist cause, even repairing a Venator hulk to working condition. However, his presence is not a positive one. The old master is incredibly insane and does not follow directives from the Republic Emergency Government. Worse, his constant conflicting orders to nearby clones create utter bedlam in the simplest fleet actions, necessitating a dedicated network of officers to mitigate him. In-game, Kazdan requires Fleet Officer support to balance out his debuffs and strong fleet support to crack shields before he is effective.

Master Paratus commands the Echoed Lament, a heavily modified Venator Star Destroyer. Notably, it features salvaged mass drivers and a complement of recovered droid starfighters.

Max speed: 3.25; Shield points: 15000; Hit points: 19000; 3 Vulture Droids (6), 2 Hyena Bombers (6), 2, Ugly Medium Squadrons (2)

Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser. An ancient battleship of the Republic designed over three-thousand years ago when large warships ruled the stars before advancement in weapon tech rendered them obsolete. Cheap and easy to acquire in the modern age, these vessels are ideally suited for anti-piracy duty and a powerful missile platform despite the relatively light laser armament for such a massive warship. The CSA makes extensive use of these vessels to protect their interests.

A'Sharad Hett was the son and Padawan of the legendary Jedi exile Sharad Hett, who lived amongst the Tuskens until his death at the hands of Aurra Sing. Hett would go on to become a prominent Master in his own right that fought in numerous pivotal battles in the Clone Wars. However, the loss of his father, the Republic, the Jedi Order, and the respect of his people pushed him to the point of breaking. The Fallen Master set his eyes firmly on a private war of revenge. Not just against the Emperor and Vader, but on every person that gave up on the old Order and left it to die.

Hett commands the modified Servator-class cruiser, Uli-ah Krayt (translates to: Child of the Krayt). The ship boasts extremely strong Super Heavy Proton torpedoes alongside its extensive battery of Turbolasers.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 40000; Hit points: 20250; 2 Z-95 CVI (2), 1 Z-95 CVB (2)

Servator-class Star Destroyer. The Servator-class is a refit of the Venator born from the harsh necessity of the battlefield. Republic loyalist-controlled shipyards in the early years after the coup were underequipped, lacking basic resources and their previously wide engineering talent pool. However, the few that remained led a creative effort to utilize aging hulls for sorely needed frontline battleships. The result was only partially successful. The Servator features strong firepower, at the expense of its hangar size and limited shield improvements.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 18000; Hit points: 24700 T1: 1 V-Wing (2), 1 ARC-170 (2) T4: 1 V-Wing (2), 1 J-45 Sabre (2)

Maintenance: This starship costs 150 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Servator-class Star Destroyer. The Servator-class is a refit of the Venator born from the harsh necessity of the battlefield. Republic loyalist-controlled shipyards in the early years after the coup were underequipped, lacking basic resources and their previously wide engineering talent pool. However, the few that remained led a creative effort to utilize aging hulls for sorely needed frontline battleships. The result was only partially successful. The Servator features strong firepower, at the expense of its hangar size and limited shield improvements.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 18000; Hit points: 24700 T1: 1 V-Wing (2), 1 ARC-170 (2)

Maintenance: This starship costs 150 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Madame Maarisa Zsinj is a veteran of the Stark Hyperspace War and the Clone Wars with a long-distinguished career as an Admiral within the Judicial Forces and Republic Navy. Firmly disillusioned by the rise of the Galactic Empire and the increased sidelining of female Imperial officers, she defected after being ordered to take her beloved flagship to be decommissioned. Admiral Zsinj began efficiently targeting Government ships and Imperial aligned shipping, crippling early efforts to stabilize the Core and stalling the Reconquest of the Rim. She remains at large- a testament to both her skill as a guerilla and the drop in command ability within the Imperial ranks after the fall of the Republic.

The Retaliation is a Venator-class Star Destroyer that focuses exclusively on naval supremacy. Gone are the land forces usually filling part of the hangar, including the SPHA-T. However, the ship does come with an enlarged garrison of fighters.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 15000; Hit points: 17000; 2 V-Wing (6), 2 ARC-170 (6), 2, Headhunter (6), 2 BTL-B Y-Wing (6)

Fleet commander: Admiral Zsinj’s guerilla tactics prioritize survivability and Infiltration in Depth. Starfighters, Gunships, Corvettes and Transports all gain +20% Shield Strength and +40% Movement Speed.

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

Upgradable Hero - Must be present to upgrade Required Tech: 2 Required Shipyard: Major Construction Yard Required Station: Command Relay Network

Sagoro Autem is an unyielding man. A veteran of the Senate Guard and a respected captain during the Clone Wars, Autem was forced into exile after the New Order began the purge of the Republic military. He was happily reunited with his estranged family for a time, but his sense of duty to the Republic was too strong. He vowed never to run again. Now, with elements of the Republic military reactivating to fight the former Chancellor’s illegal seizure of power, Sagoro has been promoted to Admiral and leads with unrelenting force.

The Star of Coruscant is a Secutor-class Star Destroyer that serves as Autem’s Flagship. Though the vessel features some light modifications for weapons efficiency, its true distinction is the peerless professionalism and discipline of the crew.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 30000; Hit points: 43100, 1 Z-95 CVI (3), 2 V-Wing (6), 2 ARC-170 (6), 2 Gozanti (2)

Fleet commander: Admiral Sagoro specializes in armor-focused frontline combat, resulting in a +10% Health and +10% damage boost at the cost of -25% shield strength for Corvettes, Frigates and Capital ships. This unit is UNABLE to retreat from combat. Plan accordingly.

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

Special Structures: Republic_Shipyard_3 Republic_Uplink_Command

Queen Apailana of Naboo. Raised to be Queen of Naboo at little more than a girl, Queen Apailana is still a formidable monarch and a voracious defender of the Old Republic. An attempted assassination by the Empire has seen her shed her world’s peaceful ways to bring justice to those victimized by the New Order.

Bravo Home is an Acclamator-class Frigate, heavily modified by the Royal Naboo Security Forces into a truly one-of-a-kind vessel for the personal use of the monarch of Naboo. It sports a vastly improved shield systems and swaps its concussion missiles for the indigenously designed Ion Pulse Missile launchers. The Bravo Home is further defended by the elite squadron Bravo Flight wielding N-1 starfighters to provide ferocious fighter support.

Jedi Haven: Queen Apailana provides a safe haven for Jedi Refugees at great personal risk. Whenever she orbits a planet, she can recruit up to THREE (3) Jedi Refugee Squadrons at one time.

Max speed: 2.5; Shield points: 15000; Hit points: 12000; 1 N-1 Starfighter (3); 1 Delta-7 Interceptor (3); 2 N-1B Starbomber (4)

Queen Apailana proved to be a formidable monarch and a voracious defender of the Old Republic. The war between the New Order and the Republic resulted in the glorious liberation of Coruscant from the grasp of the Chancellor, in no small part due to Apailana’s contributions to the war effort. The Queen now works tirelessly with the reformed Republic Senate to reintegrate the former territories and to reform the structural failings that allowed the Empire to arise.

The RNS Queen Amidala IV is an Imperial Star Destroyer that sports an experimental Ion loadout stolen from the Imperial Department of Military Research, heavily modified by the Royal Naboo Security Forces. It features an improved shield system and a strong compliment of Naboo starfighters and bomber variants. On a small plaque near the bridge, a flowing script reads "Named for the pride of our world, to carry on her spirit."

Imperator-class Heavy Star Destroyer. Equipped with weak shields but very thick armor, the Imperator is excellent at outlasting enemy warships. Its primary batteries, located besides its superstructure, have long fire range. While the ISD-1 does not possess a lot of firepower, the combination of high range weapons and durability have made it a formidable warship. Effective at long range ship vs ship combat. Vulnerable to bombers. All Star Destroyers have long range but slow firing weapons.

Imperial-2-class Heavy Star Destroyer. The ISD-2 takes the solid concept of the ISD-1 and improves it further, particularly boosting firepower. Its primary batteries have been upgraded from dual to octuple turbolasers, and it replaces its 6 trench-based laser cannons with ion cannons. The ISD-2 also gains 33% more shieldstrength and carries TIE Interceptors instead of TIE Fighters. While a marked improvement over the ISD-1, the ISD-2 is a significantly more expensive warship, and still relies on imperial doctrine of slow-firing but longer range weapons. Effective at long range ship vs ship combat. Vulnerable to bombers. All Star Destroyers have long range but slow firing weapons.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 20000; Hit points: 42000; 2 Z-95 (4), 1 Y-Wing (0)

Required Planets: Coruscant
Special Structures: Republic_Shipyard_3

Tector-class Heavy Star Destroyer. Equipped with a stronger shield than the ISD-1, the Tector excels at pure ship-to-ship combat. Its primary batteries, located besides its superstructure, have long fire range and its edges brim with heavy concussion missile launchers. However, it lacks a ventral hangar and can’t field any fighter support. Effective at long range ship vs ship combat. Vulnerable to bombers. All Star Destroyers have long range but slow firing weapons.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 25000; Hit points: 42000

Maintenance: This starship costs 400 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Required Planets (Republic): Ringo_Vinda, Rendili, Rothana, Allanteen
Special Structures (Republic): Republic_Shipyard_3

A relic of Galactic Republic's naval limitations, the Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser is a powerful defensive platform boasting impressive layered armor and powerful shield generators for even by modern standards. While not as conventionally powerful as modern vessels of it's size, the Praetor is more than capable of holding the line.

Max Speed: 3.5; Shieldpoints: 100000; Hitpoints: 450000; 2 V-Wing (6), 2 ARC-170 (6), 1 Gozanti (1)

Maintenance: This starship costs 4125 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Required Planets (Empire, Republic): Ringo_Vinda, Rendili, Rothana, Allanteen
Special Structures (Empire): E_Shipyard_3
Special Structures (Republic): Republic_Shipyard_3

Small Target, Weak, Dogfighter

The Variable Geometry Self-Propelled Battle Droid, or simply Vulture Droid, is a small unmanned fighter that relies on numbers to overwhelm the enemy. While the droid was only lightly armored and armed, it was fairly fast and maneuverable, and helped by its small target profile the Vulture is hard to hit making it surprisingly durable while dogfighting. Produced en mass, these cheap droids were deployed in the thousands at a time by the CIS during the Clone Wars. Best used to swarm lightly armored starfighters, and buy time for more capable fighters to arrive.

Dogfighter, Heavy, Sturdy, Indigenous

The hardy Utapauan Porax-38 features strong High-Capacity shields and thick armor, but also achieved notoriety for its modular design. While durable, the Porax presents a sizable target profile while turning and suffers from poor handling in a dive. This makes it especially vulnerable to anti-large weaponry while dogfighting, where it relies on its flares to counteract missile ordnance. Despite these shortcomings, its survivability and customization options made it a favored craft among bounty hunters or forward-deployed escorts long after the Clone Wars.

Ignores Nebulae, Small Target, Dogfighter, Solar Sails, Interceptor Shielding, Powerful Engines

This unit ignores the effect of nebulae on its shields.

The expensive Miy'Tok Starfighter comes fully equipped with an advanced power management system and two solar sails, generating additional power for its engines, shield generator and weapon systems, providing a boost to the Miy'Tok's combat performance. More capable than the small and nimble Miy'Tok interceptor, the larger Miy'Tok is a capable fighter craft, its only real weakness being its large target profile due to its sail, and lack of heavy weaponry to combat heavily armored foes. Best used to dogfight lightly armored craft.

Large Unit, Anti-Large, Ion Torpedo, Armor-Piercing, Astromech, High Capacity Shielding, Powerful Engines

The large Miy'Til Bomber is a fast and durable heavy strike bomber deployed on rare occasions by the Hapes Consortium. With an emphasis on speed and durability it can outrun most fighter craft, especially when diverting additional power to its already powerful engines. It can execute fast hit & run strikes, heavily debuffing the shields and armor of an enemy starship upon hit to support friendly starships, or stay around for longer and deal serious damage to both shields and armor with its dual ion and advanced torpedo launchers. Best used to attack and debuff large enemy starships, bringing down the shields and armor of hostile craft to more manageable levels for the rest of the Hapan Starfleet to take on.

Armor: Heavy 2x Medium Laser, 2x Adv. Proton Torpedo, 2x Ion Torpedo Agility: 1.725 Max Speed: 4.0 SP: 55(3/s) HP: 70 5 Models per squadron.

Adv Proton torpedo: ignores shields, great vs armor. 26 | 25 | 24 DMG vs L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 475m range. Applies -33% Max HP debuff to Fighter/Bomber/Gunship/Corvette for 14s Ion torpedo: crippling debuff, great vs shields, no hull DMG. 500 DMG vs starship shields, 15s reload, 375m range. Applies -33% Max SP, firepower, speed debuff to Corv/Frig/Cap/Structure for 14s

Land Bombing Run Unit Bombing Run Ordnance: Ion Charged Bombs, effective against shielded targets. Stuns vehicles. Bombing Run Type: Carpet Bombing

Hapan Battle Dragon. The main ship of the line for the Hapan Royal Navy, the Battle Dragon is as elegant as it is efficient. It can maintain a surprising volume of firepower towards any one target by synchronizing its weapon reload speed with the rotation of the two dishes they are mounted on. Dispite its small size, this allows the Dragon to spew a hail of turbolaser and ion cannon fire at its target. While this makes the Battle Dragon an amazingly effective ship against single targets, it cannot focuss its supremely optimized fire sequence at more than one target at a time.

This unit ignores the effect of nebulae on its shields.

Max speed: 3.0; Shieldpoints: 8000; Hitpoints: 8000; 1 Miy'Til Bomber (1), 1 Miy'Tok Fighter (1)

Maintenance: This starship costs 120 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Dogfighter, Anti-Light, Adv. Armor, Glass Cannon, Heavily Armed

The Basilisk War Droid is an ancient, mountable, semi-sentient, unshielded aircraft whos head is made up entirely of guns. Flanking the rider are two missile launchers and a pair of arms equipped with long durasteel claws. While designed 4000 years ago these updated models come equipped with advanced armor, and foldable wings for added in-atmosphere stability. Best used against lightly armored craft, where these warmachines can shred whole squadrons in single volleys. As the designated light-armor wrecking crew the Mandalorian Crusaders used to ride these babies for miles!

Armor: Heavy 2x Light Laser, 1x Medium Laser, 2x HE-Missile Agility: 1.875 Max Speed: 3.0 HP: 35(1/s) 7 Models per squadron.

Light laser: rapid-fire, short-ranged, weak vs armor 5 ||| 5 | 4 | 2 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 0.5s reload, 150m range. Medium laser: mid-ranged, good vs armor. 12 ||| 12 |10 | 8 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 2.0s reload, 250m range. High-explosive missile: long-Ranged, AOE, weak vs armor, no shield penetration. 15 ||| 15 | 8 | 4 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 20s reload, 500m range.

Equipped with heavy shields and armor, heavy concussion missiles, heavy ion cannons, and dual turbolasers, the Jehavey is the embodiment of Mandalorian power in a small package.

Armor-Piercing, Dogfighter, Interceptor Shielding, Advanced Engines

An ancient starfighter that has survived four millennia in use in countless fleets across the galaxy. Famed for its light, nimble frame, moderate shielding and heavy armament. The already impressive speed of the craft is even more improved at the cost of weapon power with s-foils. All these features have given the Aurek-class Tactical Stikefighter a long and impressive history. The One-Two punch of the Proton Torpedo shaving off the hull of a target starfighter and Medium Lasers packing a strong punch makes the Aurek have a strong alpha strike while it’s speed and fast recharging Interceptor Shields allows it to evade reprisal from slower or slow firing enemies. This however means the Aurek is vulnerable to fast interceptors with rapid fire lasers or missile weapons that can punch through the shields to the weak hull.

Armor: Medium 2x Swiveling Medium Laser, 1x Proton Torpedo Agility: 2.55 Max Speed: 4.0 SP: 20(4.5/s) HP: 30 6 Models per squadron.

Medium laser: mid-ranged, good vs armor. 12 ||| 12 |10 | 8 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 2.0s reload, 250m range. Proton torpedo: ignores shields, good vs armor, inaccurate. 20 | 18 | 16 DMG vs L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 425m range. Applies -25% Max HP debuff to Fighter/Bomber/Gunship/Corvette for 14s

This is the only Hammerhead you're ever going to get so stop asking us! The Hammerhead-class Cruiser was the staple of the Old Republic starfleet for over 3000 years. It's forward-facing long range main turbolaser cannons in combination with its small hangar made for a versatile light frigate with great forward range. But, the Hammerhead is vulnerable from any direction but its front aside from two anti-starfighter laser batteries, and after its hugely succesful lifespan the Hammerhead was eventually phased out in favour of ships without this weakness. A well-rounded light frigate ideal for long range fire-support.

Max speed: 2.5; Shield points: 3000; Hit points: 3000; 1 Ancient Sith Fighter (0)

Hidden away in long forgotten tombs and vaults for a call that never came, these ancient ships have now been reawakened to return the glory of the Sith Empire. Massively outclassed by modern ships, the Interdictor-class is now relegated to the role of a moderately armed, interdiction-capable light cruiser. Armed with a contingent of turbolasers, the Interdictor-Class can engage similar frigates and smaller cruisers, although it lacks the means to adequately defend itself against starfighter attack.

Harrower-class Dreadnought. An ancient warship of the Resurgent Sith Empire. Famed for the siege of the capitol of the Galactic Republic on the orders of the mad Sith Emperor and his followers making the sith great again. The Harrower is covered in turbolasers across it’s massive hull, making it a true Dreadnought of its age. This however makes it vulnerable to highly shielded vessels and starfighters. Harrower makes up for its lack of anti-starfighter weapons with enough holes in its body to become a fry cook at the Krusty Krab. Each opening is a hangar filled with ancient Sith Fighters.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 25000; Hit points: 60000; 12 Sith Fighter (24)

Maintenance: This starship costs 1700 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Anti-Large, Dogfighter, Armor-Piercing, Astromech

The Incom built Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 was designed for the Republic in the late stages of the Clone Wars and is the predecessor to the X-Wing, also designed by Incom. While ineffective against the CIS' swarms of small droids, the Arc-170 is heavily armed and capable of piercing starship armor, making it an excellent fire-support Starfighter. It is also equipped with an astromech for onboard repairs and two rear turrets, making it a capable dogfighter, and up close its otherwise inaccurate Heavy Lasers can deal heavy damage to large targets such as gunships. Excellent when combined with V-wings to screen smaller craft that the Arc-170 itself has difficulty hitting reliably. Best used to attack large targets such as gunships or for supporting bombers against (unshielded) starships.

Armor: Medium 2x Heavy Laser, 1x Rear Light Laser Turret, 1x Proton Torpedo Agility: 1.65 Max Speed: 3.0 SP: 35(3/s) HP: 38(1/s) 6 Models per squadron.

Heavy laser: long-ranged, great vs armor. 24 ||| 24 | 23 | 21 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 3.0s reload, 450m range. Proton torpedo: ignores shields, good vs armor, inaccurate. 20 | 18 | 16 DMG vs L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 425m range. Applies -25% Max HP debuff to Fighter/Bomber/Gunship/Corvette for 14s

Standard Ugly Starfighters equipped with a Hyperdrive allowing for use without a carrier. Very Large Unit, Anti-Light, Repair Crew, SLAM Engines

The Naboo-built PT-1 uses advanced SLAM engines that would later be used on the K-wing. Focussing mostly on speed over every other trait, the PT-1 is poorly armored and shielded for a gunship, but can easily outrun most opponents. After the Battle of Naboo made clear the need for area-denial weapons, the PT-1 was armed with High Explosive missiles to quickly wipe out large groups of lightly armored craft. The Rebellion makes thankful use of these against the Empires TIE swarms.

Armor: Medium 2x Medium Laser, 2x HE-Missile Agility: 1.5 Max Speed: 7.5 SP: 220(5/s) HP: 150(1/s) 3 Models per squadron.

Medium laser: mid-ranged, good vs armor. 12 ||| 12 |10 | 8 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 2.0s reload, 250m range. High-explosive missile: long-Ranged, AOE, weak vs armor, no shield penetration. 15 ||| 15 | 8 | 4 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 20s reload, 500m range.

Shrewd and utterly fearless, General Solomahal is a Lutrillan famous for his wartime heroics in the Clone Wars. Despite this, he was not spared in the quiet purges of non-humans in the weeks following the arrival of the New Order. The old general is now a fugitive and drifter, haunting cantinas and offering his experience as a legendary forward-deployed recon leader to smuggle those targeted by the Empire to freedom.

Solomahal’s ship, the Quadstar, is a CEC YV-888. It’s been customized with VLS missiles and sophisticated electronic warfare systems, alongside an aftermarket stealth module.

Agility: 1.5 Max Speed: 3.0 SP: 750(20/s) HP: 1150(3/s)

Fleet commander: Solomahal brings years of reconnaissance knowledge to the field, allowing those serving under him to interpret sensor data rapidly and think on their feet. All units gain a +50% FOW Reveal when he is on the battlefield. Additionally, Gunships and Corvettes enjoy -20% Ability Recharge time, +25% to Damage and Movement Speed, and +10% to Shields.

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

Special Structures: Republic_Shipyard_1 Republic_Uplink_Command

Corellian Engineering Corporation Carcus Destroyer-273-class. Fast and agile, the CD-273 is a compact heavy frigate that hits hard but is only lightly armored. It is equipped with power engines and a low range missile jammer that protects the ship from torpedo and missile fire, making up for its weak hull integrity. It can also hack into enemy systems to drain 3000 shield points over 30 seconds, and severely reduce enemy accuracy. Very effective against corvettes and light frigates. Vulnerable against heavily armored targets.

Max speed: 4; Shield points: 7500; Hit points: 6000

Maintenance: This starship costs 100 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Required Planets (Republic): Corellia
